scope_limitation_statement: Because 100% (2,000 / 2,000) of the independent CompPhish V4 samples contain valid HTML documents, both Policy 3 and Policy 4 routed exclusively to V3 Dual. This evaluation provides NO independent empirical validation of routing behavior on non-HTML inputs (such as plain text emails, SMS messages, or binary files) where Policy 3 and Policy 4 diverge.
